notes: 2026-09-10 fact pass. REBRAND CONFIRMED: the church now calls itself Zion City. Its own site is zioncity.me (the seed record had no website), and the Assemblies of God directory lists it as 'Zion City, Reverend Waylon D Sears', so the AG affiliation still holds. Name field changed to 'Zion City' with 'Victory Worship Center' kept in aka; the slug was left alone. ADDRESS VERIFIED, NOT CHANGED: the geocoder's failure was not a bad address. Zion City's own contact page lists the Flowing Wells campus at '2561 W. Ruthrauff Rd. Tucson, AZ 85705', which is exactly what was seeded, so it is kept and geocode stays 'missing' for tools/geocode.py to retry. Other campuses on that page, none of which have their own record here: Oro Valley, 2350 W Tangerine Rd, Oro Valley AZ 85742; Santa Cruz, 1775 W Ajo Way, Tucson AZ 85713; Downtown, 2 East Congress St, Tucson AZ 85701; and Nogales, Av. Patras/El Greco, Heroica Nogales, Sonora, Mexico (out of scope). The seed note's 'Copper Mountain campus' does not appear on the current campus list - it may have closed or been renamed. Leadership page names Waylon Sears and Dana Sears as Senior Pastors, leading since 2017, so the seeded names were right but the title is 'Senior Pastor', not 'Lead Pastor'; roles updated. Elders listed (not recorded as preachers): Doug Calo, Wardrick Griffin, Jake Herrington, Michael Hood, Mickey Lovejoy, Lamont Nesbitt, Art Wadlund. The seed's 'Pastors Zane & Jan' lead does belong to this church after all - it is the stale description on the old @VictoryAssembly channel, referring to Zane and Jan Anderson, who pastored here for about two decades; Zane Anderson is now described elsewhere as Apostolic Overseer rather than lead pastor, and that was not confirmed on zioncity.me, so he is not recorded. MEDIA: the seeded @VictoryAssembly channel is dead (newest uploads look like 2011-2012) and has been moved to other_media; current preaching is on @ZionCityme (channel id UCVmyUMb6hiVlt8TPOeyt3Mg), where sermon titles name the speaker, e.g. 'Follow God First | Normal Christianity | Pastor Waylon Sears'. Other names appearing as preachers on that channel include Pastor Chrissy Martinez and visiting speaker Pastor Wayne Drain; neither is on the leadership page, so neither was added - check whether Chrissy Martinez is on staff before reviewing her.
